div.div: 4 وَقَعَ الجَبَلُ عَلَى بَابِ الكَهْفِ فَأَوْطَدَهُ The mountain fell upon the entrance of the cavern, and stopped it up with its ruins. Occurring in a trad. IAth says, One should only say وَطَدَهُ; or perhaps وطده is a dial. form. Another relation gives أَوْصَدَهُ. (L.) See also 1.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
